passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Saurauia tristyla DC..
The native range of this species is Nepal to Nansei-shotō (Ishigaki-jima, Iriomote-jima) and Peninsula Malaysia. It is a tree and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.
